subject.title: fix(discord): guard parseDiscordGatewayInfoBody JSON.parse against malformed API responses

question: Should maintainers refresh and land this narrow gateway-metadata-only guard, or fold the same hunk into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99090?
rationale: Two open dirty branches touch the same parser, and choosing the landing path is coordination rather than a line-level patch defect.

options.title: Refresh This Narrow PR
options.body: Rebase this branch onto current main, preserve the newer gateway metadata tests, and land only the gateway parser guard.

options.title: Use The Broader PR
options.body: Let the broader Discord JSON parse PR own both the gateway parser and migration-store cleanup if maintainers want those changes together.

recommendation.title: Refresh This Narrow PR
recommendation.body: Rebase this branch onto current main, preserve the newer gateway metadata tests, and land only the gateway parser guard.
